text:
jenna_events: quick brainstorm  want to lock a webinar topic and rehearsal dates. thinking: 'Resilient Inference: demo-first failover patterns' aimed at engineering/platform leads. 40m + 15 QA. preferred dates: Tue 2026-06-09 or Thu 2026-06-11. thoughts?
ava_marketing: yes — highlight customer wins + a simple playbook. short hook for social needed.
sam_content: draft abstract: "Keep LLM features online when traffic spikes. Live demo of routing, fallbacks, and low-cost mitigation patterns + a take-home notebook." short + punchy.
mike_prod: demo outline: 1) normal hosted flow, 2) simulate noisy hosted (latency), 3) automatic route to dedicated pool, 4) fallback to quantized model. show token-cost comparisons. will prepare demo script and a recorded fallback clip as backup.
tom_runtime: i'll prep 2 visuals: latency vs batch size and cache-hit savings. request: what's the expected seq length distribution? would tune charts to be realistic.
leo_growth: reg flow: include a workload checkbox (chat/search/embedding) to auto-tag. capture UTM: webinar_failover. plan small paid push 72-24h prior.
diego_ops: logistics: greenroom 25m. can provision isolated demo sandbox + rotate demo keys daily. will add a safety rollback script and a smoke test.
jenna_events: run-of-show (40m):
0:00-0:04 - intros
0:04-0:12 - customer vignette (8m)
0:12-0:28 - live demo (Mike + Tom) 
0:28-0:32 - ops patterns & checklist (Diego)
0:32-0:36 - cost playbook (Ava)
0:36-0:40 - CTA + resources
0:40-0:55 - live Q&A
jenna_events: rehearsals: full dry run Mon 6/8 10am PT; tech check day-of (6/9) 9:35am PT. confirm availability plz.
mike_prod: contingency list: smoke test script `./smoke-demo.sh`, env toggle REDWOOD_TARGET=(hosted|dedicated|fallback), pre-recorded fallback video. will rehearse switching endpoints twice.
ava_marketing: promo timeline: announce 14 days out, benchmark visual 4 days out, speaker bios 1 day prior. short landing page copy by EOD.
sam_content: landing microcopy: "Join engineers for hands-on patterns to keep LLM features reliable and cost-effective. Includes demo notebook and checklist."
leo_growth: lead routing mapping: chat->SDR-A, search->SDR-B, embeddings->SDR-C. export registrants to CRM and trigger nurture.
diego_ops: greenroom checklist: mic check, recording, captions, sandbox health, rollback ready, presenter perms, backup video, network monitor, calendar link in chat.
opsbot: calendar invite created by jenna_events for 2026-06-09 16:00 UTC. attendees: jenna_events, ava_marketing, sam_content, mike_prod, tom_runtime, leo_growth, diego_ops.
jenna_events: action items: Ava - social + image by 5/30; Sam - landing page + abstract by 5/28; Mike/Tom - demo scripts & smoke tests by 6/3; Diego - sandbox + rollback by 6/5; Leo - reg form + tagging by 5/31. will send updated run order after dry run. :rocket:
